spanish: Y partieron hijos de Israel desde Raamses hacia Sucot, como seiscientos mil a pie los varones, aparte de pequeños.
grammarChanges: Removed the definite article that narrowed מִטָּף (undetermined masculine singular, 'the little ones' as a class) to one specific child; rendered as indefinite plural 'pequeños' to preserve the unmarked collective sense without narrowing or adding a concept.
readerNote: Chose indefinite plural 'pequeños' (no article) for the Hebrew undetermined collective noun, since a bare Spanish singular 'pequeño' without an article would read as the adjective 'small' rather than the noun 'the little ones.'
